text:
rachel-h: Heads-up — Mateo Garcia (Senior Infra Eng) hit a regional train strike, ETA now ~11:45am. His loop is 09:30-15:00 with a hands-on lab at 14:00. He noted wheelchair accessibility + dairy allergy. Can we adjust?

tony-l: Which parts are flexible? I own the 09:30 design sync and 11:00 architecture deep-dive. 14:00 is the hands-on lab that really needs onsite hardware.

april: I booked Lab Room C with a test machine. If he's late we can run the early chats remote and keep the lab if he can make the 14:00 slot. We may need to ship a loaner machine if he can't.

recruiter-bot: Candidate profile: Mateo Garcia, timezone CLT, international travel, ADA flag: wheelchair_assist, dietary: dairy_allergy. Contact: mateo@example.com.

rachel-h: Proposal: 1) Create backup Meet for first two sessions 2) Reserve Accessible Space D (ramp+low table) 3) Put a dairy-free boxed lunch on hold 4) Courtesy taxi coverage if he misses the last connection. @facilities can you confirm accessible parking and ramp access?

facilities: Accessible parking confirmed (Spot A1). Ramp access to Lobby B enabled. Reserved Accessible Space D 11:00-16:00. We'll set out a low table and noise-reduction panel on request.

frontdesk-bot: Visitor prereg complete for "Mateo Garcia". Printed badge will be at reception. Parking permit code emailed to candidate.

calendar-bot: Backup Meet created: https://meet.google.com/meet-mateo. Added join link to 09:30 and 11:00 events. Reserved Accessible Space D and Lab Room C 13:30-16:30.

rachel-h: Panel ask: please add the Meet link to your calendar invites and be ready to switch to remote for 09:30 + 11:00. We'll keep the 14:00 lab in-person. Tony, can you move your 11:00 to 13:00 if needed?

tony-l: I can swap 11:00 -> 13:15 (short slack between interviews). Confirming I still want to run the lab in-person if candidate makes it.

april: I'll prepare the lab kit; if he needs to use his own device we have a loaner GPU laptop (NVIDIA 3080) ready to ship, ETA courier 2 hours. Who signs off on shipping?

rachel-h: People Ops approves one-way loaner shipment for test day. Shipping cost on company card; candidate returns device in pre-paid envelope. April, coordinate with ops-shipping and cc me.

recruiter-bot: Message queued to candidate (posted to thread for transparency):

```
Candidate message:
Hi Mateo — sorry about the train strike. We can run the morning interviews remotely; a backup Meet link is: https://meet.google.com/meet-mateo. We've reserved Accessible Space D and will have a dairy-free lunch for you. If you miss the last train we can cover a taxi up to $120 (send receipts to hr@redwood.ai). Please let us know if you need the loaner GPU laptop shipped.

Panel message:
Team — Mateo may be delayed. Backup Meet links added to early slots. Lab equipment reserved for 14:00; loaner laptop available if needed. Reception has his badge and accessible parking. I'll update again at 10:45.
```

rachel-h: Sent to candidate at 08:40 — candidate replied: "Thanks, I'll aim for the 14:00 lab, will let you know about the laptop."

facilities: Dairy-free boxed lunch order placed (labelled: "Mateo G — dairy-free").

april: Shipping arranged with ops-shipping. Tracking: 1Z999AA10123456784, ETA 2h. I labeled it with loaner-serial LG-3080-17.

tony-l: Quick note for panels: please avoid offering dairy snacks and leave space to toggle captions on for accessibility.

frontdesk-bot: Badge printed for "Mateo Garcia". Reception has accessible seating ready.

rachel-h: Update at 10:50 — candidate on metro, expected 11:45. We'll run 09:30 & 11:00 remote, keep the 14:00 lab in-person. If he arrives earlier we'll move him into Accessible Space D to rest.

recruiter-bot: Candidate arrived 11:40, checked in at reception.

rachel-h: Great — Mateo is onsite and in Accessible Space D. Lab kit present. Thanks everyone. Closing loop: ran morning sessions remote, in-person lab at 14:00 completed, candidate appreciated the dairy-free lunch and the accessible setup. Taxi not needed. :white_check_mark:
